name: GPS watches
question: Which watch has the published features you need?

filters.label: Battery in GPS mode
filters.hint: Compare runtime in a named GPS mode.
filters.edge_case: Record one named mode using the brand’s wording; solar or low-power estimates are Brand estimate.

filters.label: Multi-band GNSS
filters.edge_case: Do not confuse multiple satellite systems with multiple frequency bands.

filters.label: Weight
filters.edge_case: Record whether the published weight includes the strap; incompatible measurements are Measured differently.

filters.label: Offline maps
filters.hint: Require maps stored on the watch.
filters.edge_case: A breadcrumb trail alone is not an offline map.

explainer.title: Why one watch has many battery numbers
explainer.text: GPS settings, display use, solar charging and power-saving modes affect runtime. Keep the exact named mode with the evidence. Brand estimates stay visible but do not participate in filtering.
